description:
BROE auctioneers is pleased to present 6 Castlegrange Green to the market. This superb extended three-bedroom semi-detached home is in excellent condition throughout, offering bright and comfortable living spaces along with a beautiful private landscaped, west-facing rear garden.

This attractive property combines modern upgrades with generous outdoor space, making it an ideal home for families, couples, or anyone looking for a well-maintained residence that is ready to move into.

The home has been carefully maintained and upgraded over the years, featuring a new kitchen, main bathroom, windows, doors, and a new driveway that includes an electric charging point, in addition to the landscaped rear garden.

Inside, the house is bright and airy. Upon entering, you are greeted by a hallway that leads to a spacious lounge. Double doors open from the lounge to the kitchen, which flows into a large sunroom overlooking the beautifully landscaped, private, west-facing garden.

The first floor includes three well-proportioned bedrooms, a master ensuite, and a main family bathroom.

At the rear, you will find a newly landscaped, low-maintenance west-facing garden that offers privacy and is not overlooked, creating a peaceful outdoor space perfect for relaxing or entertaining while enjoying the afternoon and evening sunshine.

Additionally, there is an impressive 30m² shed, providing exceptional storage and versatility. Its generous size lends itself to various uses, including storage, a workshop, hobby space, or a home office.

This property is conveniently located in the mature and popular Castlegrange development, close to Clondalkin Village and its numerous amenities, including shops, bars, and restaurants. The N7 and M50 road networks are also nearby, allowing for easy access to all parts of Dublin.

With its excellent condition, modern updates, generous accommodation, and exceptional rear garden, this property offers a fantastic opportunity for a home that requires little immediate work.

A viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the quality, privacy, and space this wonderful property has to offer.

To register your interest, please contact Shauna O’Brien at BROE auctioneers today.
